items.titleZh: 拉法·卡玛拉将首次亮相巴西大奖赛，奥康因关系紧张离队
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队决定让法国车手奥康不再为车队参赛，2027年新秀拉法·卡玛拉将提前在本周末的巴西大奖赛上亮相。由于奥康与车队关系日益紧张，墨西哥的热烈争吵成为压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草，车队负责人小林良太决定让这位法国人休息。

items.originalTitle: Rafa Camara to debut in F1 Brazil GP as Esteban Ocon out at Haas
detailZh: 拉斐尔·卡马拉将在F1巴西大奖赛上首次亮相，因为埃斯蒂班·奥康在哈斯车队缺席
拉斐尔·卡马拉将在巴西与哈斯车队一起首次参加一级方程式比赛，因为埃斯蒂班·奥康将缺席2026赛季剩余的比赛
拉斐尔·卡马拉加入哈斯一级方程式车队，备战2027赛季
哈斯一级方程式车队决定埃斯蒂班·奥康将不再为车队参赛，2027赛季的新人拉斐尔·卡马拉将在本周末的国内赛事中提前亮相。随着奥康与车队关系的日益紧张，在墨西哥的一场激烈争吵成为了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草，车队负责人小林昭雄决定让这位法国人休息。
法拉利青训车队的卡马拉，他已经签约哈斯车队，将在2027年取代奥康，将在伊塔乌图巴赛车场驾驶VF-26赛车。
"我们已经通知埃斯特班·奥康，他本赛季不会回到TGR哈斯F1车队的一个赛车席位，"科马茨解释道。
"这样的决定从来都不是轻率做出的，就像在墨西哥城的情况一样 - 但当时，就像现在一样，我们认为这是车队未来发展的最佳利益所在。车队和埃斯特班之间最终展开的对话仍然是内部事务，我们将继续尊重闭门会议的私密性。"
detailEn: Rafa Camara to debut in F1 Brazil GP as Esteban Ocon out at Haas
Rafa Camara will make his Formula 1 debut with Haas in Brazil as Esteban Ocon will sit out the remainder of 2026
Rafael Camara joins Haas F1 Team for 2027

The Haas F1 team has decided Esteban Ocon will not race again for the squad, with 2027 debutant Rafa Camara getting an early debut this weekend on home soil. Following increasingly strained relations between Ocon and the team, a heated argument in Mexico proved the final straw that made team principal Ayao Komatsu decide to bench the Frenchman.
Ferrari junior Camara, who had already been signed by Haas to replace Ocon for 2027, will take the wheel of the VF-26 at Interlagos.
"We have now notified Esteban Ocon that he will not return to a race seat with TGR Haas F1 Team this season," Komatsu explained.

"Such decisions are never made lightly, as was the case in Mexico City - but then, as now, we feel this is firmly in the best interest of the team moving forward. The conversations that ultimately unfolded between the team and Esteban remain an internal matter, and we will continue to respect the private nature of closed-door situations."

keyPointsEn: Esteban Ocon will not race for Haas anymore

TGR Haas F1 Team can confirm that Esteban Ocon will no longer compete on its behalf in the 2026 FIA Formula 1 World Championship. 
Rafael Câmara will now partner Ollie Bearman in the team at the São Paulo Grand Prix.
Rafael will make his Formula 1 debut on home-soil this year having last month been announced as one of TGR Haas F1 Team’s full-time driver signings for the 2027 FIA Formula 1 World Championship.
